changes.title: Quran Radio Rapid-Fail Circuit Breaker & 429 Shield
changes.description: Implemented consecutive stream failure tracking in play_next_after. Detects premature audio stream termination (< 3s elapsed or < 384,000 bytes read), introduces an asynchronous backoff pause (2.0s) between attempts, and halts the queue after 3 consecutive failures to eliminate Discord HTTP 429 message rate limit warnings.

changes.title: Catalog Slug Resolution & 100% Feed Health Verification
changes.description: Corrected podcast RSS feed endpoints for reciters A3 (Abdul Basit: abdul-basit-abd-us-samad), A11 (Abdur Rasheed Sufi: abdur-rasheed-sufi-soosi), and A39 (Noreen Muhammad Siddique: noreen-muhammad-siddique-al-duri-via-abu-amr). All 46 reciters verified healthy with HTTP 200 responses.

changes.title: Voice DNS Resolution Resilience & Exception Shielding
changes.description: Implemented safe_connect_voice with automated retries for transient Discord RTC gateway DNS resolution drops (ClientConnectorDNSError on *.discord.media). Protected !join, !quran, and button interactions with informative troubleshooting alerts.

changes.title: Recompiled Standalone Desktop Launcher (MakkaLauncher.exe)
changes.description: Rebuilt MakkaLauncher.exe bundling the latest bot engine with Cloudflare browser User-Agent headers, rapid failure protection, verified Quran Central catalog mappings, and voice DNS resilience.

changes.title: Quran Central RSS Audio Streaming & A# Reciter Namespace
changes.description: Integrated qurancentral.com podcast RSS audio provider with unambiguous A# reciter identifiers (A1-A46) and direct remote MP3 streaming.

changes.title: Dual-Message Provider-Separated !reciters Directory with Interactive Pagination
changes.description: Split the reciter directory into two clean Discord embed messages (Quran Foundation and Quran Central) with interactive previous/next arrow button navigation.

changes.title: Unified Full Surah & Radio Mode with CDN Stream Resilience
changes.description: Extended !quran full and radio commands to support both namespaces with in-memory TTL caching, and injected browser User-Agent headers into FFmpeg to eliminate Cloudflare 403 Forbidden stream dropouts.

changes.title: Quran Radio Pause & Resume Stream Resilience
changes.description: Engineered intelligent pause and resume tracking with PCM byte-accurate timestamp persistence and -ss fast-forward seeking fallback when remote CDN connections reset.

changes.title: Recursive Playback Loop & Queue Burnout Protection
changes.description: Added strict voice connection validation in play_next to prevent rapid queue emptying and infinite auto-refill loops when disconnected.

changes.title: Self-Healing Channel Join & Cleaner Radio Logging
changes.description: Improved !join to handle existing connections and channel switching gracefully without client errors, and suppressed benign 404 logs during radio refill.

changes.title: Pure Quran Foundation API Streaming Architecture
changes.description: Pivoted audio playback entirely to high-fidelity direct MP3 streaming from the Quran Foundation API. Deprecated legacy YouTube playback commands (!play, !play live, !haram) due to YouTube anti-bot verification barriers.

changes.title: Interactive What's New Changelog Modal
changes.description: Integrated a dynamic release changelog modal with offline fallback data, tag-based change pills, expandable version history accordion, and a floating desktop trigger button.

changes.title: AGENTS.md & Repository Guidelines Standardization
changes.description: Standardized prompt archiving, dual-write planning documents, and automated history synchronization across the backend and frontend repositories.

changes.title: Standalone PyNaCl Voice Libraries Bundling
changes.description: Fixed voice connection errors in standalone desktop executables by packaging native sodium binaries and cryptography modules.

changes.title: Expanded Halal/Haram Keyword Verification
changes.description: Broadened content verification filters with extensive Arabic script and topic recognition, enforcing case-insensitive checks.

changes.title: Mandatory Discord DAVE Protocol (E2EE Voice)
changes.description: Upgraded voice engine to discord.py v2.7.0 with native Dave encryption support, eliminating WebSocket 4017 disconnect codes.

changes.title: Non-Stop Quran Radio Mode (!quran radio)
changes.description: Introduced automated, continuous randomized Surah queueing for unending community listening without stream disruption.

changes.title: Byte-Accurate Stream State Failover Transfer
changes.description: Embedded PCM byte stream tracking into Master heartbeats, allowing Standby instances to fast-forward directly to the exact second of disconnection upon failover.

changes.title: Full-Surah Pagination Retrieval
changes.description: Increased verses-per-page query limits up to 286 verses to ensure complete playback for long chapters like Surah Al-Baqarah.

changes.title: Android Termux Support & 3-Column Surah List
changes.description: Added ARM64 Linux launcher script for Termux and optimized !surah output into clean 3-column messages.

changes.title: Quran Foundation API Interactive Navigation
changes.description: Integrated interactive Discord UI buttons for flipping through verse translations and playing recitation audio inline.

changes.title: Makka Live Bot & Web Dashboard Launch
changes.description: Initial release of the Discord audio streaming engine and companion web control dashboard.
